<p class="section-kicker">Doctoral thesis · Georgia Tech · 2020</p>

## Modeling for inversion in exploration geophysics

My thesis develops abstractions and performance strategies for large-scale
seismic inversion. It introduces tools for understanding numerical performance
across hardware architectures and explores how Devito’s symbolic interface and
just-in-time compiler make sophisticated wave-equation solvers both accessible
and computationally efficient.

The central idea is separation of concerns: researchers should be able to
describe the mathematics clearly while the software generates optimized,
parallel implementation code.

[Read the full thesis](https://smartech.gatech.edu/handle/1853/62766){.btn .btn-light}
:::

::: {.thesis-topics}
